tolerance_policy.protected_relative_error: abs(reconstructed-stored) / max(abs(reconstructed), abs(stored), 1e-6 * robust median feature magnitude)
tolerance_policy.absolute_tolerance: max(8 * float32_epsilon * robust median feature magnitude, 1e-12)
tolerance_policy.above_hybrid_tolerance: absolute error > absolute tolerance AND protected relative error > relative tolerance
tolerance_policy.near_zero: max(abs(reconstructed), abs(stored)) <= protected relative denominator floor
